title: Interpretable weight-space programming builds transparent transformers and brain encoding models
abstract: arXiv:2611.18114v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural networks are powerful predictors, yet their opacity limits their usefulness in science, where the goal is explanation rather than mere prediction. In neuroscience, for example, deep encoding models accurately predict brain activity in response to natural stimuli, but struggle to reveal which stimulus features drive those predictions. Here we introduce interpretable weight-space programming (iWSP), a method in which an LLM agent iteratively builds interpretable models by explicitly programming their weights and features in code, without gradient-based training (backpropagation). Without backpropagation to tune parameters, the agent must draw on its prior knowledge and reason over previous trials to hypothesize, hand-craft, and refine human-interpretable computations mirroring the workflow of a human scientist. translated_title: 可解释权重空间编程构建透明Transformer与大脑编码模型
translated_abstract: 神经网络是强大的预测器，但其不透明性限制了它们在科学中的价值，因为科学的目标是解释而不仅仅是预测。例如在神经科学中，深度编码模型能够准确预测大脑对自然刺激的反应活动，却难以揭示究竟是哪些刺激特征驱动了这些预测。在此，我们提出可解释权重空间编程（iWSP），这是一种由LLM智能体通过在代码中显式编写模型权重和特征来迭代构建可解释模型的方法，全程不使用基于梯度的训练（反向传播）。由于没有反向传播来调优参数，智能体必须依靠其先验知识并对先前的试验进行推理，从而提出假设、手工构建并改进人类可理解的计算，这一流程类似于人类科学家的工作方式。LLM审计证实了这些手工构建模型的可解释性。我们首先通过让iWSP构建（任务）来验证该方法的有效性
tldr: 该论文提出可解释权重空间编程（iWSP），让LLM智能体在不使用反向传播的情况下，通过显式编写权重和特征代码来迭代构建透明的Transformer和大脑编码模型，从而实现真正可解释的科学建模。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces interpretable weight-space programming (iWSP), where an LLM agent iteratively builds transparent transformers and brain encoding models by hand-crafting weights and features in code without backpropagation, achieving genuine interpretability.
